key_insight: UniMedSeg unifies visual examples, interactive prompts, language instructions, and 2D/3D medical images in one Transformer-based segmentation framework.
clinical_relevance: A single model that handles multiple annotation and prompt types could simplify deployment and improve segmentation consistency across diverse medical workflows.
method: Maps heterogeneous inputs into a shared sequence space for unified in-context segmentation.
Uses Decoupled Split Attention to reduce long-context attention cost to linear complexity.
Trains one model across multiple paradigms without task-specific branches or fine-tuning.
evidence_signal: The model was trained and evaluated on a large corpus from 27 public datasets and reported state-of-the-art results on visual in-context, interactive, and language-guided segmentation.
watch_item: Performance may depend on large-scale heterogeneous training data and careful handling of long visual contexts in real-world deployment.
paper_title: UniMedSeg: Unified In-Context Learning for Multi-Paradigm 2D/3D Medical Image Segmentation
